distilled_patterns.description: Agent repeatedly executes superficial search queries with quotes or complex clauses without reading candidate document text, causing search loops and timeouts.
distilled_patterns.effect: Use concise keyword queries and inspect candidate document pages immediately upon retrieval.

distilled_patterns.description: Agent exhausts step budget (24-25 steps) in ungrounded searches instead of converging on identified evidence by step 15-18.
distilled_patterns.effect: Enforce step budget awareness: synthesize and conclude with best available grounded answer before step limit.

distilled_patterns.description: Model outputs narrative explanations or conversational text instead of concise target values, or fails to cleanly invoke finish action.
distilled_patterns.effect: Constrain outputs to direct target value without conversational framing.
